title: Nina Maps Configuration
description: Configuration schema for a nina-maps map.

baseMap.description: The base map style to use. Must be a key present in the styles record.

layerOrder.description: An array of layer IDs in the order they should be rendered. Each ID must reference an item of type "layer" in the items record.

excludeFields.description: List of field names to exclude from the info popup
List of field names to exclude from the info popup
List of field names to exclude from the info popup

expandedItems.description: An array of item IDs that should be expanded in the layer tree. Each ID must reference an item of type "folder" in the items record.

popupLayout.description: How the info popup presents multiple features: "tabs" gives each feature its own tab, "stacked" lists every feature one after the other.
